name: Pâte Sucrée
summary: Sweet, crisp, almost biscuit. Fruit tarts and lemon tarts.

steps.text: Cream the butter and sugar, then add the egg.
Add the flour and stop the moment it comes together.
Chill flat, roll cold, line the tin.
Blind bake to a full golden colour.

bake.notes: Bake it darker than feels right. Pale sucrée goes soggy under filling.

notes: Rolling between parchment saves a lot of swearing.
